name: Network Map
tagline: open-wa drawn as a transit network: five patterned lines (Easy API, SocketClient, Embedded, Agent, Integrations) meeting at the Easy API interchange, with station cards, a journey planner and service information for developers choosing how to connect WhatsApp to their app.
logo: An interchange mark: a solid blue line and a double-track amber line meet at a white interchange ring on an ink tile; on hover or focus a train dot runs through the interchange, the ring swells and the wordmark's hyphen extends like a line joining.
